steps.title: Implant checks in
steps.caption: Malware on the finance host HR-FIN-01 opens its first HTTPS beacon - a small repeated signal the malware sends home - to a fresh C2 domain. a new external domain appears in egress logs (records of traffic leaving the network); no reputation history
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.
